release_notes:
v1.0.8+11 - Native Agora RTC Camera Integration & Real-Time Connection HUD
- Direct Agora RTC C++/NDK native hardware camera driver (eliminated Android camera lock)
- Fully automated zero-click entry (removed manual 32-character key modal)
- Real-time Connection Telemetry HUD pill (latency, 2/2 participant count, live ping)
- Tap-to-open Agora Connection Inspector modal for latency, bitrates, audio engine, and token security
- Normalized studio room channels to guarantee teacher & student land in the exact same Agora room
